snippet.title: Forgotten Villa - Official Teaser
snippet.description:
A weekend getaway turns into a nightmare.
What begins as laughter among friends quickly descends into silence… and something watching from the dark.

Wishlist Now : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4154970/Forgotten_Villa/

Background Music : 
https://youtu.be/pX-zZ5JRV3Q?si=xNmdkbKriFNcFqPY

Uncover the villa’s buried secrets, face the unseen, and survive the truth that was never meant to be found.

🔹 Explore. Discover. Fear.
🔹 Wishlist on Steam: 
🔹 Follow for updates and behind-the-scenes horror reveals.
